description:
Fetch a named scenario over the AI-compute supply chain.
Available: 'taiwan-strait' (4 TSMC disruption scenarios), 'tokyo-earthquake' (Japan memory-fab exposure).
Returns the scenario's summary plus its substrate serialized from the interactive page's own data modules — assumption scenarios and affected assets with per-item sources and authority tiers, capped lists shipping their true totals. The propagation SIMULATION itself remains interactive-only at the returned URL.
name: scrutica_get_scenario
